input.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 exclusivity so the Company is restricted only from operating a competing "Deerskin"-branded consumer web site during the term, with carve-outs for other channels, internal development and acquisitions.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a restriction on the products we may buy, build or sell, so our preferred position is to delete the covenant on the Company in Section 6.1; as a fallback we have narrowed it to the named subject matter (a self-contained "Deerskin"-branded consumer web site) for the term only, with carve-outs for other channels, internal development and acquisitions. The open-ended sweep covering "products substantially similar to Deerskin Products" and "companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled" would restrain our broader business, while HDI's exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand for the Site is preserved.

ops.oldText: the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
ops.newText: the Company shall not itself establish or operate a self-contained, "Deerskin"-branded web site offering Deerskin Products directly to consumers on the Internet (provided that nothing in this Section 6.1 shall restrict the Company from (i) offering Deerskin Products or any other products through any other channel, including its catalogs, retail stores and third-party marketplaces, (ii) developing, sourcing, marketing or selling any products, or (iii) acquiring, being acquired by, merging with or owning any person engaged in any business, and this Section 6.1 shall not apply following the expiration or termination of this Agreement)
